svg.text: Bất biến Sổ cái & Quy tắc
AWS Managed Security, Identity, Container Registry & Observability Services
Private App Subnets — Amazon ECS Fargate Cluster (dbs-dev)
ECS Service: dbs-api (APP_ROLE=api | 2 Fargate Tasks | Port 3000) — ĐƯỜNG ĐỒNG BỘ (SYNC PATH)
ECS Service: dbs-worker (APP_ROLE=worker | Không mở cổng HTTP) — ĐƯỜNG BẤT ĐỒNG BỘ (ASYNC PATH)
ECS One-Off Tasks & Verification Jobs (dbs-migrate & check:invariants)
Private Data & Queue Layer (RDS, Valkey, SQS + DLQ)
Phân quyền DB Roles: dbs_api (Sync) | dbs_worker (Async) | dbs_migrator (DDL)
• Bảng Sync: users, customers, accounts, transfers, idempotency_keys
• Bảng Sổ cái [APPEND-ONLY TRIGGER]: ledger_entries (DEBIT/CREDIT, balance_after)
• Bảng Hậu kiểm [APPEND-ONLY]: audit_log, risk_decisions, fraud_flags,
TLS rediss:// + Auth Token | Bọc bởi Opossum Circuit Breaker (100ms)
• Rate Limit Counters (100 req/min/IP, 10 tx/min/khách) & Fraud Velocity
• Valkey lỗi/chậm -> Fail-open có kiểm soát + tăng redis_fallback_total
Amazon SQS Queues & Dead-Letter Queues (Chặn dbs-api-task)
